title: Find Factors
description: Write a Zig program that finds and prints all factors of the number 28.
verificationTest: output.includes('Factors') && output.includes('1') && output.includes('28') && output.includes('14') && output.includes('7') && output.includes('4') && output.includes('2')
hints: A factor is a number that divides evenly into another number
Iterate from 1 to the number itself
